using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using ValidationModules;

namespace Sample;

public sealed partial class PetValidator : IValidatorFor<global::Sample.Pet> {
    public static readonly PetValidator Instance = new();

    private PetValidator() { }

    public void Validate(ref ValidationContext ctx, global::Sample.Pet value) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.PostalCode)) ctx.AddRequired("postal_code");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.HTTPStatusLine)) ctx.AddRequired("http_status_line");
